text: When a new partner is admitted, the goodwill is valued at the amount of cash paid by the new partner.
options: Option A: True
Option B: False
Option C: It depends on the method of valuation
Option D: It depends on the type of business
explanation: When a new partner is admitted, the goodwill is valued at the amount of cash paid by the new partner. This is because the cash paid by the new partner is considered as the value of goodwill brought in by him.
subject: Accountancy
chapter: Ch 3: Reconstitution - Admission of a Partner

text: Hidden goodwill arises when the new partner brings in cash but the amount of cash is less than the value of goodwill.
options: Option A: True
Option B: False
Option C: It arises when the new partner brings in cash equal to the value of goodwill
Option D: It does not arise when the new partner brings in cash
explanation: Hidden goodwill arises when the new partner brings in cash but the amount of cash is less than the value of goodwill. This is because the difference between the value of goodwill and the cash brought in is considered as hidden goodwill.
